name: Pass or Die 💣
desc:
Welcome to Pass or Die! In a circle of 20 players, you have to pass the bomb before it explodes in your hands. The last person standing wins.

💣 Pass the bomb when your turn comes
✨ Use powers to affect the gameplay
💰 Earn coins with every round you survive
😎 Buy skins and animations to look cooler
📈 Watch your stats grow
😃 Invite your friends to play

+50% Coins for Premium players!
❤️ LIKE the game for more updates
